visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a finished bowl of herbal chicken soup in the foreground and a large red Dutch oven in the background. A woman with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and an apron, is seen tasting the soup with a wooden spoon, smiling warmly at the camera. She then picks up a chicken wing with her hands and eats it enthusiastically. (2) The scene shifts to raw ingredients: bundles of fresh 'dog tail grass' roots are shown, followed by a tray of chopped roots. Hands are seen washing the roots in a bowl of water. (3) The roots are then placed into a stainless steel pressure cooker and water is added. The lid is locked, and the stove is turned on. (4) Close-ups show the pressure cooker venting steam. Later, the woman prepares a whole chicken, washing it thoroughly. (5) She then blanches the chicken in a pot of boiling water with ginger slices, lifting it out with a wooden paddle and a strainer multiple times before submerging it in an ice bath. (6) The herbal broth is strained from the pressure cooker into a bowl. The chicken is then placed into the red Dutch oven, and the herbal broth is poured over it. (7) Various ingredients like red dates, dried mushrooms, and ginger slices are added. Rice wine and water are poured in. (8) The pot is brought to a boil and then covered with a lid to simmer. (9) After simmering, the lid is removed to reveal the finished soup. Clams are added to the pot for a final boil. The video ends with a final shot of the soup bowl and social media handles.
